entries.head: transfer over

senses.en: to move money to another account

example.en: Transfer over the deposit before Friday.

entries.l1_note: 转账是 transfer (over)；transfer to sb 是转给某人。

entries.head: send over

example.en: Send over your account number and I'll pay you.
example.zh: 把你的账号发过来，我转给你。

entries.l1_note: 发过去是 send over；send out 是群发。

entries.head: wire over

senses.en: to send money by bank transfer

example.en: The landlord wants the rent wired over by the fifth.
example.zh: 房东要求五号前把房租汇过去。

entries.l1_note: 电汇是 wire (over)；wire 单独也是接线。

entries.head: pay in

senses.en: to put money into a bank account

example.en: I paid in the cash at the counter.

entries.l1_note: 存钱进账户是 pay in（英式常用）；美式多说 deposit。

entries.head: pay out

senses.en: to give money from a fund or account

example.en: The insurance paid out after three weeks.

entries.l1_note: 付出是 pay out；pay off 是还清。

entries.head: cash in

example.en: I cashed in the gift card at the mall.
example.zh: 我在商场把礼品卡兑了。

entries.l1_note: 兑现是 cash in；cash in on 是借机获利。

entries.head: cash out

senses.en: to sell an investment or withdraw a balance

example.en: He cashed out before the market dropped.

entries.l1_note: 套现是 cash out；取现金是 withdraw cash。

entries.head: bank on

example.en: Don't bank on the bonus this year.

entries.l1_note: 指望是 bank on；不是“在银行上”。

entries.head: count on

senses.en: to trust someone to do something

example.en: You can count on me to cover the deposit.

entries.l1_note: 依靠是 count on；count in 是算上。

entries.head: fall back on

senses.en: to use something as a backup

example.en: If the sale falls through, we can fall back on savings.

entries.l1_note: 退路是 fall back on；fall behind 是落后。

entries.head: dip into

senses.en: to start using money you saved

example.en: We had to dip into the emergency fund.
example.zh: 我们不得已动了应急金。

entries.l1_note: 动用存款是 dip into；dip 单独是蘸。

entries.head: put by

example.en: She puts by a little every month for her parents.

entries.l1_note: 存着是 put by；put aside 更常用。

entries.head: scrape by

senses.en: to survive with just enough money

example.en: We scraped by on one salary that year.
example.zh: 那年我们靠一份工资勉强过。

entries.l1_note: 勉强过是 scrape by；scrape through 是勉强通过考试。

entries.head: tide over

senses.en: to help someone through a difficult period

example.en: Can you lend me 500 to tide me over till payday?
example.zh: 能借我五百撑到发工资吗？

entries.l1_note: 接济是 tide someone over；tide 是潮水。

entries.head: bail out

senses.en: to rescue someone or something with money

example.en: His parents bailed him out of debt again.

entries.l1_note: 救急是 bail out；bail 单独是保释。

entries.head: write off

senses.en: to accept that money is lost

example.en: The bank wrote off the loan after two years.
example.zh: 两年后银行把这笔贷款核销了。

entries.l1_note: 勾销是 write off；write down 是记下来。

entries.head: square up

senses.en: to pay what you owe someone

example.en: Let's square up for the tickets now.

entries.l1_note: 结清是 square up (with)；settle up 同义。

entries.head: clear off

example.en: He cleared off the credit card before the interest hit.
example.zh: 利息来之前他把信用卡还清了。

entries.l1_note: 还清是 clear off；clear up 是收拾、放晴。

entries.head: default on

senses.en: to fail to pay money you owe

example.en: He defaulted on the loan after losing his job.
example.zh: 失业后他这笔贷款断供了。

entries.l1_note: 违约是 default on；不是“默认开启”。

entries.head: top off

senses.en: to fill something up to the top

example.en: Top off my phone credit before the trip.
example.zh: 出门前把我手机话费充上。

entries.l1_note: 充值加满是 top off（美式）；top up 偏英式。

entries.head: blow through

example.en: He blew through his bonus in two weeks.
example.zh: 他两周就把奖金花光了。

entries.l1_note: 花光是 blow through；blow up 是爆炸。

entries.head: fritter away

senses.en: to waste money or time in small amounts

example.en: She frittered away her savings on takeout.
example.zh: 她的存款都点外卖花掉了。

entries.l1_note: 零碎浪费是 fritter away；不是“炸物”。

entries.head: squirrel away

example.en: She squirreled away a little each week.

entries.l1_note: 偷偷存是 squirrel away，画面是松鼠藏坚果。

entries.head: tuck away

senses.en: to keep money in a safe place

example.en: I tucked away 200 a month for emergencies.

entries.l1_note: 收着是 tuck away；tuck in 是塞进衣服。

entries.head: salt away

senses.en: to save money over a long time

example.en: They salted away enough for a down payment.

entries.l1_note: 攒钱是 salt away，老派但仍在用。

entries.head: stash away

example.en: He stashed away cash in a drawer.

entries.l1_note: 藏起来是 stash away；stash 单独是藏。

entries.head: ante up

example.en: Everyone ante up ten yuan for the gift.

entries.l1_note: 出份子是 ante up，来自扑克下注。

entries.head: pony up

example.en: The company finally ponied up for new chairs.
example.zh: 公司最后才掏钱换了椅子。

entries.l1_note: 不情愿掏钱是 pony up，美式口语。

entries.head: pay down

senses.en: to reduce a debt by paying part of it

example.en: We're paying down the mortgage early.

entries.l1_note: 还本金是 pay down；pay off 是还清。

entries.head: run up

senses.en: to owe a lot of money because of things you bought

example.en: He ran up a huge bill on his credit card.
example.zh: 他信用卡刷出了一大笔欠款。

entries.l1_note: 欠下账单；run up against 是遇到困难。

entries.head: go up

example.en: Vegetable prices went up again this week.

senses.en: to move to a higher position

example.en: Go up to the fifth floor and turn left.

entries.l1_note: 价格上涨用 go up；go up the stairs 是“上楼”，带宾语。

entries.head: come into

senses.en: to receive money or property from someone who died

example.en: She came into a small apartment after her aunt passed away.
example.zh: 她姑姑去世后，她继承了一套小房子。

example.en: Come into the office and we'll talk.

entries.l1_note: 继承义常用 come into money/property；进入义后面直接跟地点。

entries.head: hold on to

example.en: Hold on to the handrail — the bus is about to start.

senses.en: to keep something rather than lose or sell it

example.en: Hold on to the receipt in case you need a refund.

entries.l1_note: hold on to 的 to 是介词；代词放后面：hold on to it。

entries.head: pay for

example.en: I'll pay for the groceries — you get the coffee.
example.zh: 菜钱我来付，你去买咖啡。

senses.en: to suffer the results of something

example.en: He lied to the client, and now he's paying for it.
example.zh: 他对客户撒了谎，现在正在付出代价。

entries.l1_note: pay for + 东西/后果；pay 单独用是“付款”，pay for 更强调为某物付钱。

entries.head: account for

example.en: How do you account for the missing cash?
example.zh: 少了的现金你怎么解释？

entries.l1_note: account for 可指解释，也可指占比例。

entries.head: amount to

example.en: The extra fees amount to almost a hundred yuan.
example.zh: 额外费用加起来快一百块了。

entries.l1_note: amount to 可指金额总计，也可指“等于/意味着”。

entries.head: average out to

example.en: The monthly bills average out to about 3,000 yuan.
example.zh: 每月账单平均三千左右。

entries.l1_note: average out to + 数字；不是“平均出去”。

entries.head: invest in

example.en: She invested in a good desk chair.
example.zh: 她花大价钱买了一把好办公椅。

entries.l1_note: invest in + 东西/项目；不是“投资到”。

entries.head: bottom out

example.en: House prices finally bottomed out last winter.
example.zh: 房价去年冬天终于触底了。

entries.l1_note: bottom out 是不及物“触底”；不是“底部出去”。

entries.head: buy off

example.en: They tried to buy off the inspector.

entries.l1_note: buy off + 人；不是“买下”。

entries.head: go without

example.en: We had to go without hot water for two days.
example.zh: 我们两天没热水也凑合过来了。

entries.l1_note: go without + 东西；不是“没有就走”。

entries.head: jack up

example.en: The hotel jacked up prices during the vacation.
example.zh: 酒店在假期抬高了价格。

entries.l1_note: jack up + 价格；不是“千斤顶”。

entries.head: live off

example.en: He's still living off his parents.

entries.l1_note: live off + 人/收入；不是“住在外面”。

entries.head: max out

example.en: I maxed out my credit card on the trip.
example.zh: 我旅行时把信用卡刷爆了。

entries.l1_note: max out + 卡/额度；不是“最大值出去”。

entries.head: round down

example.en: Round down to the nearest yuan.
example.zh: 四舍五入到整元，往下取。

entries.l1_note: round down 是向下取整；round up 是向上。

entries.head: shoot up

example.en: Rent shot up after the new subway opened.
example.zh: 新地铁开通后房租猛涨。

entries.l1_note: shoot up 是不及物“猛涨”；不是“射上去”。

entries.head: be in debt

example.en: He's been in debt since the car accident.
example.zh: 车祸之后他就一直欠着债。

entries.l1_note: be in debt 是欠债；in debt to + 人。

entries.head: cover the cost

example.en: The deposit should cover the cost of repairs.
example.zh: 押金应该够覆盖维修成本。

entries.l1_note: cover the cost of + 东西；不是“盖住成本”。

entries.head: crunch the numbers

example.en: Let me crunch the numbers before we decide.
example.zh: 定之前让我先把数字算一下。

entries.l1_note: crunch the numbers 是“做计算”；不是“嚼数字”。

entries.head: hard up

example.en: I'm a bit hard up this month.

entries.l1_note: hard up 是“缺钱”；不是“硬起来”。

entries.head: run up a bill

example.en: They ran up a huge bill at the hotel.
example.zh: 他们在酒店欠了一大笔账。

entries.l1_note: run up a bill/debt 是欠账；不是“跑上去”。

entries.head: well off

example.en: Her family is quite well off.

entries.l1_note: well off 是“富裕”；不是“很好地离开”。

entries.head: careful with money

example.en: He's very careful with money.

entries.l1_note: careful with money 是“花钱谨慎”；不是“小心钱”。

example.en: I opened an account at the bank near my office.
example.zh: 我在公司附近的银行开了户。

Take a number and wait for your turn.
I deposited money into my savings account.

Check your balance before you pay.

Walk up to the counter when your number is called.

example.en: I'm saving up for a new laptop.
Put money aside every month, even a little.

entries.head: put something in the piggy bank

example.en: She puts her coins in the piggy bank.
Making coffee at home saves me thirty yuan a week.
example.zh: 在家做咖啡一周省三十块。

example.en: I'll wait for a sale before I buy the chair.
I buy secondhand books on a flea market app.
Set a goal and check your progress every month.
example.zh: 定个目标，每月看看进度。

example.en: I spend less when I cook at home.
My parents always told me to save for a rainy day.
example.zh: 我爸妈总说要有备无患存点钱。

example.en: I ride a bike to work when it's not raining.
I pay the bills online on the fifth.
We made a budget for the wedding.
Use an app to keep track of spending.
We cut back on takeout this month.
You can pay online with a card.
It's hard to stick to the budget at the supermarket.
We went over budget on the hotel.
Check the statement for charges you don't know.
example.zh: 查账单，看看有没有不认识的扣款。

example.en: It's hard to make ends meet in this city.
example.zh: 在这个城市收支平衡很难。
